en: A wholesome state that has not yet arisen is a condition, by way of object-condition (*ārammaṇapaccaya*), for a wholesome state that has not yet arisen. (Abbreviated.

There are eighteen [modes] in the case of the object, three in the case of predominance (*adhipati*), and eighteen in the case of decisive support (*upanissaya*). (The "arising" [category] is similar to the "not-yet-arisen" [category].)
